players.product: oncology and immunology drug-discovery programs with Recursion's AI-driven design platform (healthcare business)

quarterly_data.signal: Merck KGaA announced a four-way collaboration with NVIDIA, Microsoft and Dawn Health to build an AI-facilitated patient support program model - a 24/7 AI companion grounded in clinically reviewed content, with escalation to a nurse or healthcare provider - for people with rare tumors, initially desmoid tumors and NF1 plexiform neurofibromas, to be piloted in key markets in Europe. NVIDIA contributes AI technology and services (Nemotron models, NeMo Guardrails and other NeMo tools), Microsoft provides cloud services (Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Kubernetes Service and others) and Dawn Health leads product development on its Dawn Platform; it expands an earlier Merck KGaA - Dawn Health partnership.
